positions.title: Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Tasked with fixing bugs and implementing new features in a memory controller for Intel's new 3D XPoint nonvolatile memory based DIMM

positions.title: Embedded Software Intern
positions.description:
Integrated force feedback in NASA's Cockpit Situation Display (CSD) application in C++. Revised, combined, and expanded force feedback code written by previous interns.

Developed and integrated a custom made mouse with force feedback called the Haptic Trackball. Created an API for communication between the Trackball and computer using C++. Successfully integrated Haptic Trackball in CSD.

Created a multi-threaded logger that extracts critical force information from the CSD. Logger controlled by a dialog box the user can interact with.

Developed a versatile script in python to process, extract, and organize key information from trial data from individual trial participants recorded by the CSD. Script handled hundreds of large .txt files successfully and quickly.

Unified different force models into a single build, removing the need to build different projects every time a certain force model was to be used in a test. Program autonomously applies certain force models depending on the states of the CSD, or the options selected by the user. This dramatically reduced the bring-up time for different testing scenarios.
